description: Metadata for confirmed public pages of the Leverhulme Centre for the Future of Intelligence on www.lcfi.ac.uk. Each URL was confirmed with one bounded GET that returned the page HTML. A Cloudflare challenge, HTTP 403, or non-HTML response is not stored. Rows store a title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights label. Page text is not stored. Rights stays unknown unless that page states a reuse licence. creative_commons means only CC0, CC BY, or CC BY-SA. uk_ogl is used only when the page states the Open Government Licence. The centre is not a UK government publisher. A missing publication date stays unknown. Updated, modified, last-updated times, and copyright years are not publication dates. This catalog is not a belief collector.
